newsitem.title: UK: Air Foyle opens new sales office in the U.S.
newsitem.headline: Air Foyle opens new sales office in the U.S.

text.p: UK-based specialist cargo operator and GSA for the Antonov Design Bureau, Air Foyle said it has opened a new sales office in Houston, Texas at the heart of the U.S. oil industry.

It has appointed Patti Walker as chief executive of Air Foyle North America Inc where her responsibilities include managing the company's current representative office in Seattle, the new Houston office and an administrative office in Minneapolis.

"This three pronged approach -Houston, Seattle and Minneapolis - covering the major industries, as well as regions and time zones. demonstrates Air Foyle's dedicated commitment to the North American cargo charter business. Our North American operation has already successfully operated eight AN124 charters out of the U.S. within the first six weeks of 1997," said Air Foyle chief executive Chris Foyle. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
